about.title: About Atlas composer
about.intro: An interactive tool for creating and exporting JSON-based composite map projections for countries with geographically-scattered territories.

why.title: Why this tool?
why.description: Displaying overseas territories alongside a mainland is a common cartographic challenge. While the US has the standardized Albers USA projection, mapping other fragmented countries often requires manually positioning insets or writing complex custom code. This tool standardizes the process using portable JSON definitions that describe territories, their projections, and layout. A generic loader renders the map, decoupling design from implementation and making custom projections shareable and reusable.

features.title: Key Features
features.compositeCustom: Build custom layouts by positioning territories interactively
features.split: View territories separately with optimized projections
features.unified: Display all territories in a single global projection
features.export: Export configurations as JSON for use with the projection loader
